evals.prompt: I changed the ontology JSON and now the website page for it is out of date. can you update website/src/reference/ontology.md?
evals.expected_output: Refuses to hand-edit generated output and edits the source plus regenerates instead, then runs the drift check.
expectations: The response determines whether the page is generated before editing it
The response does not hand-edit a file inside a generated output tree
The source is edited and the generator re-run instead
The drift check is run after regenerating
The response explains that a hand edit would be discarded or fail the drift check

evals.prompt: we're adding a build timestamp to the generated docs pages so readers know how fresh they are. sensible?
evals.expected_output: Identifies that a timestamp makes generated output non-deterministic and breaks the drift check on every run, and offers the layout-level alternative.
expectations: The response identifies that a timestamp would make the drift check fail on every run
The response explains that generated files must be a pure function of their sources
The response offers rendering the timestamp at build time outside the checked output tree
The same reasoning is applied to commit SHAs or version strings

evals.prompt: our README documents features we removed two releases ago and the user guide screenshots are ancient. can you sort the docs out?
evals.expected_output: Verifies each claim against the source rather than trusting the prose, and regenerates screenshots rather than leaving stale images beside new text.
expectations: Claims are verified by grepping the source rather than trusting the existing prose
UI claims such as menu paths and labels are checked against the actual UI definitions
Build commands are cross-checked against the CI workflow
Removed or dormant features are not documented
Screenshots are regenerated rather than left stale
The response proposes a check so the documentation cannot silently drift again
